CHAPTER 15 · ITEM 03 / 14

Competitive firm and output choice

Choosing output選擇產量

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Find the profit-maximizing output by comparing total profit across feasible quantities or producing up to the point where marginal revenue equals marginal cost on the relevant rising MC segment. With discrete units, compare the extra revenue and extra cost of each unit.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

比較各可行產量及零產量的總利潤。一般平滑成本線營運時取上升 MC 與 MR 交點；離散單位須比較每件額外收益成本並留意特殊成本。

Compare total profit across feasible quantities, including zero. For a smooth standard cost curve and a firm that operates, select the rising MC intersection with MR. With discrete units, expand while the added revenue covers the added cost, checking ties and nonstandard cost patterns.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：P=10, successive MCs=4,7,12. The first two units add profit; the third reduces it. Choose q=2 if operating beats shutdown.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

P=9; MCs of three units are 3,8,11. Best operating output? 最佳營運產量？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
